Integrating 24 cones gives the exact 256-fold simplex formula. Lagrange inversion and simplex-beta integration give all positive rational coefficients. Exact-rational code independently checks 14 facets, triple intersections, Jacobian and first seven coefficients, but universal results follow analytically.

value.rationale: BCC was proved uniquely optimal across all finite p-th lattice Voronoi moments in 2026, making its near-worst-case error probability a natural but not settled geometric reliability statistic. This exact fixed-cell endpoint law supplies both the full convergent series and concrete 128/1024/53248/5 coefficients rather than a generic exponent; it also fixes the maximum-error rare-event scale and a cubic Weibull limit. The exact probability and coefficients are not a routine lookup of known face counts or radius, and the claim does not require a new global lattice-optimization theorem.
